title: 2023 Topps Chrome Jordan Groshans Miami Marlins Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The 2023 Topps Chrome Jordan Groshans trading card is a standard-sized collectible featuring the up-and-coming baseball player from the Miami Marlins. This original card is part of the 2023 Topps Chrome set manufactured by Topps, adding a sleek chrome finish to the design. It is a base set card that will be a valuable addition to any baseball card collection, especially for fans of the Miami Marlins and Jordan Groshans.
